sources.title: BERT (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Bidirectional encoder representations from transformers (BERT) is a language model introduced in October 2018 by researchers at Google. [2][3] It learns to represent text as a sequence of vectors using self-supervised learning.

sources.title: How to Train A Question-Answering Machine Learning Model (BERT)
sources.snippet: Here I will discuss one such variant of the Transformer architecture called BERT, with a brief overview of its architecture, how it performs a question answering task, and then write our code to train such a model to answer COVID-19 related questions from research papers.
